mapper.select: select cra.es_id as id, cra.customer_id as customerId, su.name as employeeName, cra.begin_time as beginTime, cra.end_time as endTime, cra.is_connected as isConnected, cra.duration, cra.record as record from mmba_call_record_audit cra left join sys_user su on su.um = cra.um where cra.um = #{um} and cra.customer_tel = #{customerTel} and ifnull(cra.begin_timestamp, cra.timestamp) >= #{collectionTime} order by cra.begin_timestamp desc, cra.timestamp desc, cra.es_id desc
